name: TomTom N.V.
summary: TomTom N.V., together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells navigation and location-based products and services in Europe, the Americas, Asia, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Location Technology and Consumer. It offers routing, automotive, and places APIs; automotive navigation, navigation SDK for mobile, and AI agent products; maps for automated driving, map maker, maps SDK for JavaScript, and map display and places APIs.
